description: Clear a notebook’s chat history. RPC-backed (no browser). NotebookLM has no per-turn delete: the whole conversation goes. The next question then starts a fresh conversation.

conversation_id.description: A specific conversation. Defaults to the most recent one.

name: delete_chat_history

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
